items.desc: borg-ui before 2.4.1 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows a repository-scoped operator to escalate to full administrator by exploiting an unrestricted source_directories field in the backup-plan API that lacks path allow-listing. Attackers can configure a backup plan to archive the application's data directory, download the resulting archive to extract the static HS256 .secret_key, and use it to forge a JWT with sub":"admin" to access admin-only endpoints like GET /api/auth/users, achieving full application takeover without admin credentials, XSS, or CSRF.

items.desc: browser-use before 1.0.0 contains an allowlist bypass vulnerability in the SecurityWatchdog's _is_url_match function that allows attackers to bypass domain restrictions by exploiting a raw-string startswith() comparison instead of parsed hostname validation. Attackers can craft URLs using userinfo injection or domain prefix confusion (e.g..com@attacker.com or .com.attacker.com) to redirect an LLM-controlled navigation to an arbitrary host, exfiltrating sensitive data such as secrets embedded in the URL to an attacker-controlled endpoint.

items.desc: browser-use before 1.0.0 contains a URL parser differential vulnerability in SecurityWatchdog that allows attackers to bypass allowed_domains, prohibited_domains, and block_ip_addresses checks by crafting a URL with a backslash before the allowed host, exploiting the mismatch between urllib.parse hostname extraction and Chromium's WHATWG-style URL parsing. Attackers can influence an LLM-controlled navigate action, such as through prompt injection, to send requests to loopback or private addresses or arbitrary external hosts before the browser redirects to about:blank, enabling SSRF and persistent state changes on the target server.

items.title: A flaw was found in the file-psd plugin in GIMP. When processing a specially crafted PSD (Photoshop Document) image file in LAB…
items.ai: CVSS 7.8（高危）。暂无公开 POC，按常规补丁窗口安排。 影响版本：详见公告。
items.desc: A flaw was found in the file-psd plugin in GIMP. When processing a specially crafted PSD (Photoshop Document) image file in LAB color mode, the plugin does not properly validate that a fourth channel is present when the transparency flag is set. This mismatch causes the merged-image path to allocate buffers for three components while performing color conversion with four-component formats, resulting in a heap-based buffer overflow. This issue can result in an application crash, leading to a denial of service, or potentially allow for arbitrary code execution.

BusyBox ftpd Directory Traversal Arbitrary File Read and Write Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create or delete arbitrary files or disclose sensitive information on affected installations of BusyBox. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the ftpd service, which listens on TCP port 21 by default. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create or delete files or disclose information in the context of the service account. Was ZDI-CAN-27555.

PyTorch Foundation PyTorch AOTIModelPackageLoader  Directory Traversal Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of PyTorch Foundation PyTorch. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file.

The specific flaw exists within the AOTInductor model package loader. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current user. Was ZDI-CAN-33055.
